S16_decision.label: MULTIPLE
S16_decision.rationale: MULTIPLE internal bottlenecks (not community expansion). (B) 360d commercial∧domain pool: 1255/1299 (96.6%) NOT_SCORED — discovery JOIN cannot see them (current_score_per_message invariant OK; coverage gap). (C) On measured 7d capped prefilter 2500: NO_PATH_MATCH/direction=1599 (64.0%) — buyer/project conjunction not recognized. (D) Veto/hard-exclude first-loss=897 (35.9%); job_aggregator multi-label hits=454; 4/4 AI_CONFIRMED LaborX FO lost_at=discovery_prefilter_LOW (HIGH) and text-eval veto=["job_aggregator","generic_recruiter"] (message-level FO structure, not source ban). (A) Prefilter uncapped keeps only ~2.1% of 7d LOW (CT/keyword). Measured disc_v4 survivors=4/2500 (matches evidence96 hardcoded 4). Production plane: commercial_discovery_enabled=false → FLAG_DISABLED (counterfactual thereafter).
S16_decision.fix_recommendation_smallest: 1) Do NOT expand communities. 2) Ops/backfill score coverage for 8–360d commercial∧domain so JOIN can see the pool (B). 3) Keep message-level gig FO veto; carve FO+repair/trading-bot+budget exception (LaborX AI_CONFIRMED pattern) — not a LaborX source ban (D). 4) After (2)–(3), remeasure NO_PATH_MATCH on capped prefilter (C) and CT-cap bias (A). No scoring.yaml / score() threshold changes. Do not flip discovery flag in this phase.
